description:
Fables Mosaic: Little Red Riding Hood features a collection of colorful puzzles that can be solved by logic alone! 
Follow the story of Little Red Riding Hood while you solve captivating nonogram challenges!

- 100 unique nonogram levels
- Follow the story of Little Red Riding Hood
- View a gallery of completed nonograms
- Use logic to solve puzzles
name: Fables Mosaic: Little Red Riding Hood
intro: Experience Little Red Riding Hood story through logic puzzles!
